subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform — scheduling across regions

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Mar 2025 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform — scheduling across regions

Hi Carlos —

Great to hear Acme Health is interested in a technical demo. Our EU engineering team (based in Dublin/Berlin) will join to answer architecture and deployment questions. That means we need to find a time that works for your US team and for them — often that pushes into early morning Dublin / late evening US, or a midday US time that falls in the afternoon for our EU folks.

A couple of constraints to note: the US switches to DST on Mar 9, 2025 and EU not until Mar 30, 2025, so offsets this month are a bit different than later in spring. To avoid confusion, I listed slots below with explicit timezones. All times below reflect US DST in effect (EDT = UTC-4) while Europe is still on CET (UTC+1).

Proposed 60-min demo slots (we can do 45 if you prefer):
- Option A: Tue Mar 11 — 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 16:00 CET (early afternoon EU)
- Option B: Tue Mar 11 — 11:00 PDT / 14:00 EDT / 19:00 CET (late evening EU)
- Option C: Wed Mar 12 — 07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT / 15:00 CET (early AM US, late afternoon EU)

If none of those work, please tell us the 2–3 windows that are best for your team and whether you prefer an earlier (US morning) or later (US evening) slot.

I attached a short agenda and will send an invite after we lock a time. We can also record the session if you have stakeholders who can’t make the live call.

Thanks —
Aditya

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the quick options. Our engineering leadership is on West Coast time and they prefer not to join past 17:30 PT on weekdays. We do have a few teammates on East Coast who could join earlier.

Of your slots, Option C (Wed Mar 12 07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT) would be tough for most of our West Coast folks. Option A at 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT could work if we keep it to 45 minutes and focus on integration + deployment questions. Option B at 11:00 PDT / 14:00 EDT / 19:00 CET is probably too late for our EU stakeholders to join.

Would you be open to Tue Mar 11 at 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT (Option A) as a 45-minute session? If so, please send an invite with dial-in and recording.

Regards,
